data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open hotel search, type destination and pick a suggestion, choose dates, set rooms and guests, search, then filter and sort) and names all the key parameters. It adds details the true workflow doesn't have (children ages, specific filter types, check-in/check-out split) and puts the guests step before search where the true run changes guests afterward on the results page, but these are minor differences, and the steps are concrete enough to automate.
